UKG Billing v0.1.11 — Production fixes.
• Customer records now persist correctly to the local database before billing uses them.
• Automatic Cloud Sync now reliably processes newly queued changes.
• Stock audit movements now use database-authoritative stock to prevent stale-stock audit failures or duplicate deductions.
• Cloud Sync settings and validation now use the authenticated session correctly with clearer status reporting.
• Cloud Test Connection now uses a valid organization-scoped endpoint.
